name: Her Willing Sacrifice
source:
You are a maid in love with the princess of the castle you work in and she seems rather fond of you as well. Unfortunately for you both, such relations aren't exactly allowed. Will the two of you ever break free from your oppressive circumstances, or will you be cruelly separated? Maybe something supernatural will come to your aid...

[From [url=https://angelanatomy.itch.io/her-willing-sacrifice]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名女仆，爱上了你工作的城堡的公主，她似乎也很喜欢你。不幸的是，对于你们俩来说，这种关系是不被允许的。你们两个会摆脱压抑的环境，还是会被残酷地分开？也许一些超自然的东西会来帮助你……

[来自[url=https://angelanatomy.itch.io/her-willing-sacrifice]itch.io[/url]]
